system.description: A Focus for a character whose growth turns them into a towering force.

abilities.name: Enlarge
abilities.description: Grow to 3 meters, gaining Might resilience and stronger unarmed attacks while making dodges harder. The Might cost rises with each use until recovery.

abilities.name: Mighty Leap
abilities.description: When larger than normal, jump twice the usual horizontal or vertical distance.

abilities.name: Longstrider
abilities.description: When larger than normal, double your travel speed over journeys lasting at least a minute.

abilities.name: Preternaturally Strong
abilities.description: Carrying, climbing, jumping, or smashing rolls below 9 count as 9; greater sizes raise that minimum. The benefit renews after recovery.

abilities.name: Scary Big
abilities.description: Gain an asset on persuasion and intimidation, or two assets while larger than normal.

abilities.name: Bigger
abilities.description: Spend extra Might with Enlarge to reach 4 meters, ignore two moderate wounds, and deal 6 unarmed damage.

abilities.name: Towering Throw
abilities.description: When an unarmed attack damages a creature your size or smaller, throw it 1d20 feet and knock it prone.

abilities.name: Huge
abilities.description: Spend extra Might with Enlarge to reach 5 meters, ignore three moderate wounds, and deal 7 unarmed damage.

abilities.name: Towering Strike
abilities.description: A successful Might attack deals 4 extra damage, plus 1 more for each larger size increment.

abilities.name: Gargantuan
abilities.description: Spend extra Might with Enlarge to reach 9 meters, gain greater resilience and damage, and attack every creature in an immediate area.

abilities.name: Might for Mind
abilities.description: Spend Intellect instead of Might for a task, or Might instead of Intellect.

abilities.name: Colossal
abilities.description: Spend extra Might with Enlarge to reach 18 meters, gaining the Focus's greatest size benefits and making smaller creatures unable to dodge effectively.

abilities.name: Grab
abilities.description: Use a Last action and an unarmed attack to grab a target, hinder its tasks, and squeeze it for damage with an action.
